# nsh-platform-web crate

> WebAssembly backend: runs NSH apps in a browser page, rendering to the DOM, and publishes them as static sites. Version 0.6.0, targets and dependencies.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/nsh-platform-web/

## Workspace dependencies

[`nsh-base`](/crates/nsh-base/), [`nsh-bundler`](/crates/nsh-bundler/), [`nsh-core`](/crates/nsh-core/), [`nsh-dev`](/crates/nsh-dev/), [`nsh-engine`](/crates/nsh-engine/), [`nsh-testing`](/crates/nsh-testing/). It also uses 16 crates from outside the workspace.

## Features

`base-full`, `browser`, `browser-core`, `browser-tests`, `compiler`, `default`, `dev`, `linkable`, `std-crypto`, `std-zlib`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p nsh-platform-web
```
